scripts.dev: npm run build -w @repo/contracts && concurrently -k -n contracts,api,web "npm run dev -w @repo/contracts" "npm run dev -w @repo/api" "npm run dev -w @repo/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @repo/contracts && npm run build -w @repo/api && npm run build -w @repo/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @repo/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build -w @repo/contracts && npm run build -w @repo/api && node --test tests/api.test.cjs
